(HKEX Code: 9926.HK), will be presented today as part of the Plenary Session at the 2026 American Society of Clinical Oncology (ASCO) Annual Meeting in Chicago. articles.title: Ivonescimab with Chemotherapy Demonstrated a Statistically Significant Overall Survival Benefit Compared to Tislelizumab Plus Chemotherapy in 1L Treatment of Patients with Squamous NSCLC in the HARMONi-6 Study Conducted by Akeso in China

articles.summary: Promising Data Further Support Continued Expansion of Ivonescimab Clinical Development in mCRC Overall Study Population Achieved ORR of 70.8% and DCR of 100.0%; Responses Consistent Across Ivonescimab Dose Levels Combined with Chemotherapy Acceptable and Manageable Safety Profile for Ivonescimab Regimen; No New Safety Signals Observed Summit Therapeutics Inc. (NASDAQ: SMMT) today presented new results from the AK112-206 trial (NCT05382442), a global, open-label, multicenter Phase II study in first-line metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC) co-sponsored by Summit and Akeso, featuring the novel, potential first-in-class investigational bispecific antibody ivonescimab. The data were presented today at the 2026 American Society of Clinical Oncology (ASCO) Annual Meeting in Chicago.
